-- Kunden, die seit 6+ Wochen nicht da waren
-- und noch keine Reaktivierung bekommen haben (letzte 30 Tage)
SELECT
  c.id AS client_id,
  c.salon_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  c.phone,
  c.last_visit,
  c.preferred_staff_id,
  c.visit_count,
  sal.name AS salon_name,
  -- Letzte Behandlung
  s.name AS last_service,
  st.name AS last_staff_name,
  -- Tage seit letztem Besuch
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - c.last_visit)::INT AS days_since_visit
FROM clients c
JOIN salons sal ON sal.id = c.salon_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT b.service_id, b.staff_id
  FROM bookings b
  WHERE b.client_id = c.id AND b.status = 'completed'
  ORDER BY b.start_time DESC LIMIT 1
) last_booking ON true
LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = last_booking.service_id
LEFT JOIN staff st ON st.id = last_booking.staff_id
WHERE c.marketing_consent = true
  AND c.last_visit < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 weeks'
  AND c.last_visit > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
  AND sal.is_active = true
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM message_log ml
    WHERE ml.client_id = c.id
      AND ml.template_name = 'reactivation'
      AND ml.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  )
ORDER BY c.last_visit DESC
LIMIT 50;

INSERT INTO message_log (salon_id, client_id, channel, direction, template_name, message_text)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.salon_id }}',
  '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  'whatsapp',
  'outbound',
  'reactivation',
  '{{ $json.message }}'
);
